name: How long does a typical walk-in shower installation take as part of a luxury bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical walk-in shower installation take as part of a luxury bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a walk-in shower installation, as part of a comprehensive luxury bathroom remodel, varies based on factors such as the complexity of design, material selections, and any structural modifications required. While a basic shower replacement might be quicker, our focus on customized, high-value renovations means we account for design finalization, custom fabrication, and meticulous installation. AKN Design Group provides a transparent project schedule upfront, detailing milestones from initial consultation to final walkthrough, ensuring clear communication throughout the duration of your project. We prioritize craftsmanship and clear communication over rushed timelines.
